ownership: Two blocks have distinct PT/TP/TT1/TT2 maps. Each role is tied across four routes. Gate, residual readout and native head are common. Only e[2,4,4] is private; H0 is fixed.
conditional_hypothesis: Several own-supervised states may retain class-relevant local/neighborhood cues through later nonlinear propagation and controller evaluation. An early finite-width mixture bottleneck is unobserved.

graph_facts.affine_commutation: With the same affine T, row-stochastic P and nonlinearities/clipping absent or inactive, P(HW+b)=(PH)W+b in exact algebra.
graph_facts.actual_role_qualifier: PT and TP have distinct W/b; their disagreement combines parameters and placement.
graph_facts.nonlinear_order: ReLU and row clipping generally make same-map transform/aggregation order different. Benefit and sign are not guaranteed.
graph_facts.node_gate_commutator: [P(Gamma Z)-Gamma PZ]_v=sum_u P_vu(Gamma_u-Gamma_v)Z_u; Gamma is a scalar operation weight at each node.
graph_facts.capable_single_overlap: One-state conditional mixtures already have noncommuting graph computation. Candidate contrast is persistence of several recipient histories.
graph_facts.linear_limit: Commuting P/T does not collapse arbitrary distinct role/path combinations; no whole-bank reduction theorem is claimed.

limits.information: Same frozen H0 and original P; no new observations or learned support. The architecture is one structured wider network.
limits.single: A capable single can learn a sufficient representation. A gain may reflect state capacity, own supervision or optimization.
limits.bias_coordinates: Common e mean is absorbable into beta2, while optimization can differ. Retain adopted bias-coordinate single/I4.
limits.I4: With a common permissible ancestor, independent bodies can copy candidate maps/head and absorb each route e into gate beta2. This concerns the unrestricted architecture family, not fitted dominance or equivalence of independently selected caches.
limits.collapse: Identical effective gates/states yield one deterministic eval function. Four tail TRAIN draws do not create several eval functions.
limits.hidden_distance: Differences in Wo nullspace or without served-margin changes can be irrelevant. Wo0 makes every memory route source-contained.
limits.learning_and_cost: Shared map updates are coupled; routes are not independent data. Sharing does not remove state/tape/propagation work; no measured saving is claimed.
limits.gradient_delay: Saved update-one Wo delay and ordinary update-three first-gate-map reachability remain.

primary_falsifier.status: Existing complete pilot outputs and guards; no new gate or fit.
primary_falsifier.population: Whole declared population and paired blocks after complete closure; no favorable subset selection.
primary_falsifier.readouts: Repairs, harms, member-coverage acquisitions/removals, pooling losses, served net correctness and declared member/proper-loss protection.
primary_falsifier.null_interpretations: Middle-state match leaves continuation attribution unsupported. Bias-coordinate single match leaves an ordinary optimization/augmentation explanation. Coverage without served surplus is insufficient.
primary_falsifier.limit: Separately fitted middle-state comparison tests the whole interface/backward-coupling package, not a pure forward order cause.
